rag_summary:
Proctor YouRippa Cyclone
represents an ultra-heavy-duty, high-tack construction and joining tape within
the YouRippa product family, engineered for demanding wind-exposed environments.
Designed to withstand extreme site conditions, it bonds aggressively to
membranes, plastic sheeting, timber, and metal framing where standard tapes risk
peeling under wind load. It provides rapid weather-resistant sealing and
emergency site protection across walls, roofs, and temporary building wraps.

problem_keywords: slow taping on ladders and scaffolding
use_cases:
Fast, blade-free hand-tear taping of floor protection boards and corflute
sheets on jobsites

non-breathable films and site sheeting

Temporary bundling, masking, and
containment sealing during construction fitouts
rag_summary:
Proctor YouRippa Easy
is a convenient, hand-tearable trade tape engineered for effortless
cross-directional tearing without the need for knives or scissors. Formulated
with a balanced pressure-sensitive adhesive on a flexible embossed carrier, it
delivers quick tack and conformability across jobsite surfaces. It provides an
efficient solution for attaching protective films, joining temporary covers, and
general light-to-medium utility sealing.

description:
Proctor YouRippa Heavy Duty Curing & Protection Tape is an
embossed polyethylene cloth-backed protection tape coated with a natural
rubber-based adhesive, engineered specifically for temporary jobsite surface
protection. Designed with an advanced carrier that tears straight and cleanly by
hand in both directions without cutting tools, it secures floor protection
boards and concrete curing covers against heavy foot traffic. Formulated for
clean, residue-free removal, it protects delicate finished timber, stone, metal,
and cured concrete surfaces during active building works.
features:
Tears
straight and cleanly by hand in both directions without knives or scissors
Clean, residue-free removal from sensitive finishes and cured concrete
Aggressive natural rubber adhesive bonds firmly to multiple substrates
Heavy-duty embossed polyethylene cloth carrier resists tears and puncture
Waterproof backing protects seams from construction spills and wet washdowns
Secures floor protection boards, films, and concrete curing blankets
Conforms readily to corners, thresholds, and irregular profiles

Suitable for
indoor fitouts and short-term outdoor construction protection

technical.value:
Clean
residue-free removal on recommended surfaces

fire:
Standard construction trade accessory rating; low
hazard
install:
Ensure floor protection sheets, concrete, or finishes are dry and free of
loose grit and dust

Lay out floor protection boards, hardboard, or concrete
curing blankets with tightly butted edges

Tear YouRippa tape cleanly by hand
across the roll to the required length

Centre the tape directly over the seam
between adjacent protection sheets

Press down firmly along the tape line
using hand pressure or a squeegee

Ensure all edges are flat to eliminate
tripping hazards from foot traffic

Peel tape cleanly away upon project
handover without leaving sticky residue

rag_summary:
Proctor YouRippa Protect Tape (Heavy Duty Curing & Protection
Tape) is an embossed polyethylene cloth tape coated with a natural rubber-based
adhesive, engineered specifically for temporary jobsite surface protection.
Hand-tearable in both directions without cutting tools, it securely joins
corflute, cardboard, hardboard, and concrete curing blankets under heavy trade
foot traffic. It removes cleanly without leaving adhesive residue or damaging
sensitive finished surfaces such as timber, tiles, polished stone, and cured
concrete.

rag_summary:
Proctor YouRippa Silver
represents a heavy-duty, silver-faced construction and duct tape within the
YouRippa range. Featuring an embossed, high-tensile waterproof backing coated
with an aggressive pressure-sensitive adhesive, it matches silver foil membranes
and ducting. It delivers an airtight, moisture-resistant seal for joining
reflective insulation, sealing foil laps, and performing durable jobsite repairs
without requiring scissors or knives.

description:
ProctorGeo D-Rain HC (HC9 / HC10) is a flexible,
lightweight horizontal and vertical cavity drainage and acoustic separation mat.
Manufactured with a three-dimensional, high-void entangled monofilament
polypropylene core thermally bonded to a permeable non-woven geotextile filter
fabric on one or both sides, it creates a permanent drainage and ventilation
plane under standing seam metal roofs, zinc claddings, and below-ground
structures. It relieves hydrostatic pressure, rapidly channels away incidental
moisture, and provides significant acoustic damping against rain noise
drumming.
features:
Three-dimensional entangled polypropylene
monofilament core with high void ratio

Thermally bonded non-woven geotextile
filter fabric prevents fines and dirt clogging

Dampens rain impact noise on
zinc, copper, and standing seam metal roofs by up to 21 dB

Maintains an
uninterrupted drainage and ventilation cavity behind claddings and beneath
roofs

High compressive strength resisting construction traffic and cladding
fastener loads

Resistant to chemical attack, rot, mildew, and soil
microorganisms

Flexible and lightweight for fast unrolling over plywood
substrates and membranes

Relieves hydrostatic pressure in horizontal plaza
decks and vertical retaining walls

technical.value:
High hydraulic transmissivity (approx. 1.2 - 2.5 l/m·s at
hydraulic gradient 1.0)

Up to 21 dB sound reduction under metal roof

Install primary roof underlay or waterproofing membrane
over plywood substrate or structural deck

prevent fines entering the core

Fix temporarily in place with staples or
clout nails along top edges or outside the active drainage zone

Install
standing seam metal roof pans, zinc cladding, or pavers directly over the

Fasten metal cladding clips directly through the mat into the

Ensure the lower edge
discharges freely into roof gutters, drainage sumps, or perimeter weep holes

rag_summary:
ProctorGeo HC (D-Rain HC9 / HC10) is an entangled monofilament
polypropylene drainage and acoustic separation mat laminated with a non-woven
geotextile filter fabric. Sized at 9mm to 10mm thickness in roll format, it
creates a permanent drainage and ventilation plane under standing seam metal,
zinc, and copper roofs, as well as behind wall claddings and beneath plaza
pavers. Delivering up to 21 dB in rain noise damping while rapidly draining
condensation, it protects metal claddings from underside corrosion and water
ponding.

description:
ProctorGeo IRMA is a heavy-duty, water-vapour
permeable non-woven geotextile membrane specifically engineered as a protective
and water-dispersing separation layer for Inverted Roof Membrane Assemblies
(IRMA), green roofs, and protected membrane roofs. Manufactured from
high-tenacity, UV-stabilised virgin polypropylene fibers, it is installed loose
over extruded polystyrene (XPS) insulation boards beneath gravel ballast or
pavers. It prevents dirt, ballast fines, and silt from washing into insulation
joints while allowing water vapour to vent freely, mitigating rain water cooling
and maintaining roof thermal efficiency.
features:
Engineered
specifically for Inverted Roof Membrane Assemblies (IRMA) and ballast green
roofs

High water-vapour permeability prevents moisture entrapment above
insulation boards

Functions as an effective filter layer preventing silt and
ballast fines from bridging joints

Reduces rain water cooling effect by
draining up to 98% of runoff above insulation

High tensile and CBR puncture
resistance withstands rough gravel ballast and pavers

UV-stabilised virgin
polypropylene construction resists rot, mildew, and soil chemicals

Dimensionally stable, lightweight, and easy to roll out over XPS insulation
boards
Non-toxic, chemically inert, and safe for rainwater catchment systems

technical.value:
2.0 m or 3.0 m width x 50 m / 100 m
length

Ensure ballast is placed progressively to prevent wind uplift of the geotextile
during installation

rag_summary:
ProctorGeo IRMA is a heavy-duty, water-vapour permeable non-woven geotextile
engineered specifically as a filter, separation, and water-deflecting layer for
Inverted Roof Membrane Assemblies (IRMA). Laid loose directly over extruded
polystyrene (XPS) insulation beneath gravel ballast or pavers, its virgin
polypropylene fiber matrix filters out silt and prevents ballast fines from
jamming board joints while allowing vapor to vent freely. By shedding up to 98%
of surface rainwater directly to outlets, it minimizes rainwater cooling to
preserve the thermal performance of flat concrete roofs.

rag_summary:
ProctorGeo Vap represents a specialized vapour-retardant
geotextile or composite drainage membrane within the Proctor civil and building
envelope line. Engineered for subterranean, under-slab, and basement foundation
applications, it combines drainage filtration with moisture vapour control to
block ground dampness from migrating into structural building elements. It
prevents damp concrete slabs, efflorescence, and moisture-induced flooring
failures.

description:
ProctorPassive YouByute Flexi Tape is a high performance, highly
stretchable butyl flashing and sealing tape designed for complex
three-dimensional corners, penetrations, and structural junctions. Manufactured
with an exceptionally elastic creped polymer carrier coated with an aggressive,
pure butyl rubber adhesive, it stretches and conforms tightly around pipes,
ducts, window sills, and irregular apertures without tearing or pulling away.
Protected by a split release paper, it provides a continuous, durable airtight
and watertight seal in high-performance building envelopes.
features:
Highly stretchable creped carrier expands and contours around 3D corners and
curved pipes

Thick, high-tack pure butyl adhesive creates an instantaneous
waterproof bond

Conforms seamlessly to rough substrates, window sills,
penetrations, and structural corners

Split release paper backing enables
fast, precise placement without pre-stretching

Airtight and watertight
barrier compliant with Passive House envelope standards

Excellent adhesion to
timber, concrete, masonry, metal, PVC, and pliable membranes

Self-sealing
formulation seals tightly around nail, screw, and fastener penetrations
Solvent-free formulation with low VOC emissions and zero chlorine

rag_summary:
ProctorPassive YouByute Sealing Tape represents a high-tack,
multi-purpose envelope sealing tape designed to join and seal ProctorWrap and
ProctorPassive building membranes. Formulated with an aggressive
pressure-sensitive adhesive on a robust carrier, it creates durable airtight and
weather-resistant bonds across membrane laps, timber framing, steel studs, and
building sheathing. It prevents air leakage and wind-driven rain penetration,
supporting energy-efficient building standards.

rag_summary:
ProctorPassive YouRippa Duo Tape is
a heavy-duty, double-sided adhesive tape designed for concealed lap sealing and
temporary positioning of building membranes on structural framing. Featuring
high-tack adhesive on both faces of a carrier with a silicone-coated release
liner, it bonds membranes securely to timber studs, steel girts, and overlapping
sheet runs. It creates a concealed airtight weather seal between membrane layers
while preventing wind flap during frame construction.
